dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical structural indentation located on the right lateral margin posterior to the head; the opposing left margin remains smooth.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency dark-pixel clusters localized primarily on the cranial region and along the dorsal ridge line.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the pigmented grey areas and the lighter baseline skin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct indentation or notch on the right lateral margin behind the head region.
